# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current: stock
> Strata v0.1.43.1 + stock OMP 18.10.1 on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
> IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock layer split, pipeline windows 2 and 8 GiB conversation parking,
> no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090; `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with stock setup's batch slots, parking and 32K chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)),
> and on an RTX 5090 at 131,072 tokens (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)).
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> Each host's v0.1.43 + OMP 18.10.1 profile is its qualified rollback, with the same model pins and stock setup plan:
> [PRO, 262K](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.1.43-omp18.10.1/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.43-omp18.10.1/qualification.json),
> [pair, 262K and parking](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.1.43-omp18.10.1/qualification.json).
> Each current ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable; every measured gate passed in the first full run at
> `d2fac61`. The RTX 5090's full G18 passed first time, with five reduced-threshold compactions; the pair's
> G10 stage order is complete (`kept_1576`, both cards in configured order). The rollback's failed G18, rate
> probes and full rerun, and the pair's failed admission run and passing run 2, remain published.
> Scored: PRO, RTX 5090 and pair 15/18 each; rollback 16/18, 15/18 and 16/18. Pilot: 6/6, 5/6, 5/6;
> rollback 4/6, 5/6, 5/6. Tool-loop: PRO and 5090 0/3, pair 1/3; pair multifile-regression 2/3. Every new
> client execution failure count is zero; one pair scored attempt has a malformed-arguments counter despite
> client exit 0 and verifier success. Failed attempts and that protocol counter stay counted.
> PRO scored wall: 555 s against 590 s. RTX 5090: 858 s against 658 s with more work
> (315 versus 277 tool calls, 154,887 versus 107,725 output tokens); whole-batch wall per output token is about
> 5.5 versus 6.1 ms, not isolated decode latency. Pair reduced G18: six compactions in 125.4 s against one in
> 44.7 s; G16/G21 readiness remains 54.7/55.0 s on both tuples. Only Strata's engine/archive and source pins
> move; setup plans, flags and floors stay unchanged. G00 records quoted-tool-call/fenced-JSON, prompt-loan,
> PLE probe, Windows watchdog, pinned bounce-buffer and low-VRAM-warning changes; batch-slot refusal handling
> reaches only the PRO and parking progress the PRO and pair. Upstream's answer-byte-parity report is not
> measured parity from these runs. Each host's v0.1.42 + OMP 18.8.9 profile stays earlier qualified history.
> The pair's [earlier qualified 131K profile](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-disp4090-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> is rollback only after moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1`, runs stock
  OMP 18.10.1 through an SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1`,
  the PRO's current v0.1.43.1 262K profile. Its independent G23 ledger records a pass on 2026-10-13: health RTT
  5.2-13.5 ms and stream TTFT 0.191 s through the tunnel, a tunnel drop failing the turn in flight with the transcript
  intact, and nonce recall after tunnel reopen (0.76 s), client restart (0.91 s) and verified server restart (1.39 s).
  Its rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.1.43-omp18.10.1`, reaches the PRO's v0.1.43 262K rollback.
  The qualified 0.1.42 262K route and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
